title: Hoodlum Soldier Ep 1: The Choice

scenes.say: Newark, New Jersey. Streetlights flicker. A stray pitbull limps across cracked pavement.
scenes.visual: a cracked Newark street at night, flickering streetlights, a limping stray pitbull, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Gunshots echo. Sirens get closer. Nobody looks up.
scenes.visual: distant police lights glowing at the end of a dark city block, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Ali Torres, seventeen, sits low in a parked Cutlass Supreme. Hood on. Jaw clenched.
scenes.visual: a teenager in a hoodie seen from behind, slumped low in a parked Cutlass Supreme at night, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: A scar over his left eye. A thirty-eight snub in his lap. His fingers trembling.
scenes.visual: close up of a snub-nose revolver on jeans inside a dark car, trembling fingers, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: He crosses to the trap house. A little girl plays on the porch with a headless doll.
scenes.visual: a small girl on porch steps holding a headless doll under a bare bulb, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: You my brother Dre's friend? Used to be.
scenes.visual: a hooded figure standing at the bottom of porch steps at night, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: He knocks twice. A long pause. Then red and blue lights flood the street.
scenes.visual: red and blue police lights flooding a row of houses, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Courtroom. Orange jumpsuit. His mother sobbing quietly behind him.
scenes.visual: an orange jumpsuit seen from behind in a courtroom, a woman crying in the gallery, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: The judge: You got two options, son. Prison. Or the U.S. Army. You choose.
scenes.visual: a judge's bench and gavel in a wood-paneled courtroom, window light, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Ali looks down. Then up. And nods.
scenes.visual: handcuffed hands clasped, light falling across them, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Follow for Episode Two. Turn negative into positive.
scenes.visual: a folded American flag beside a red bandana on a table, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

caption: HOODLUM SOLDIER, Episode 1 of 25: The Choice. From the screenplay by Elvin Torres Sr. New episode every 48 hours.
